cards.title: Teaching Life Skills Before University
cards.body: Parents often neglect teaching essential domestic skills like laundry and cooking before children leave home. These practical abilities are crucial for young adults navigating independent life at university.

cards.title: Preparing Your Child for University Independence
cards.body: An IKEA shopping trip revealed how little domestic wisdom many parents pass on to their pre-university children. Teaching kitchen essentials and household skills is key to raising capable young adults.

cards.title: Postpartum Depression and Psychosis Treatment
cards.body: Postpartum depression and psychosis are highly treatable conditions, but only when new mothers and families can access proper care. Early intervention is critical for maternal and child wellbeing.

cards.title: Postpartum Psychosis: A Child's Perspective
cards.body: Family-centered, early-intervention models are essential for parents experiencing postpartum psychosis. Understanding this condition from children's perspectives can improve family mental health outcomes.

cards.title: Grandparenting: Joy and Emotional Challenges
cards.body: Grandparenting brings deep joy but also unexpected emotional complexities across three generations. Learning to embrace both aspects strengthens family bonds and intergenerational relationships.

cards.title: Healthy Phone Practices for Teens and Tweens
cards.body: Deciding when to give children their first phone is an important parental milestone with lasting consequences. Setting clear expectations and guidelines before purchase helps establish healthy device habits.

cards.title: Online Safety: Where Are the Parents?
cards.body: When children are hurt online, parents often bear the blame, but platforms share significant responsibility. Understanding shared accountability helps create safer digital environments for young people.

cards.title: Social Media and Children's Reward Systems
cards.body: Digital social validation activates reward systems differently than real-world social connections in children's brains. This difference could have negative impacts on developing brains and social skills.

cards.title: Building Self-Discipline in Children
cards.body: Self-discipline is a trainable capacity built through moments of conflict between impulse and intention. Understanding how to measure and develop this skill helps parents raise resilient children.

cards.title: Gratitude's Benefits for Family Wellbeing
cards.body: Emerging research reveals that gratitude has extraordinary potential benefits for mental and physical wellbeing. Teaching children to practice gratitude can improve family health and happiness.

cards.title: Nature Time Teaches Children Kindness
cards.body: Time spent in natural settings teaches children to pause, manage frustration, and develop greater compassion. Regular nature exposure can help raise more patient and emotionally resilient young people.

cards.title: Teenage Suburban Life and Community Connection
cards.body: Suburban living offers hidden benefits for families beyond initial expectations when parents help children find engagement. Community connection often emerges through involvement in local activities and schools.

cards.title: Falling Birthrates and Family Security
cards.body: Young people still want partners and children, but government policies must address the insecurity and isolation preventing family formation. Economic and social support are essential for reversing declining birthrates.

cards.title: Parenting Support and Kindness from Strangers
cards.body: Parenting emergencies can be overwhelming, but unexpected kindness from strangers can restore faith during difficult moments. These simple acts of help demonstrate the importance of community support for families.
